Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family.
One day, Tom saw a big bird near the mountain. He wanted to climb the mountain too. He asked his mom, "Can I go up the mountain?" His mom said, "No, it is dangerous. You might fall and get hurt."
Tom was sad, but he went back to the mountain. He wanted to show the bird that he could climb the mountain. When he got to the top, he was very careful. But he did not go too high.
Tom fell down and hurt his knee. He cried and cried. His mom and dad came to help him. They told him, "You should have listened to the bird. Now you must be punished." Tom was sad and learned to be careful when climbing trees.
